closed.title: Your account is closed at your request
closed.retained: Your data is kept for the legal retention periods and then erased; destruction completes within fourteen days as backups rotate. It cannot be accessed or changed while the account is closed.
closed.retained_until: Your data is kept for the legal retention periods, until at least {{date}}, and then erased; destruction completes within fourteen days as backups rotate. It cannot be accessed or changed while the account is closed.
closed.erased_note: Your non-mandatory data (phone numbers and contact details) was erased on {{date}}; what the law requires stays until its term. The account cannot be reopened after erasure.
closed.reopen_note: You can request reopening until {{date}}. After that your non-mandatory data (phone numbers and contact details) is erased automatically; what the law requires stays until its term, and the account cannot be reopened afterwards.
closed.archive_title: Your full copy, ready to download until {{date}}
closed.archive_hint: Yearly files ({{years}}) and a core file, {{invoices}} stamped invoices as issued, and {{rows}} rows, with a `README` describing the content and a `manifest` with each file's fingerprint.
closed.request_erase: Request erasure of my non-mandatory data now
closed.erase_confirm_body: Platform support will review your request, then erase what the law does not require to keep: phone numbers of customers, suppliers, employees and contract parties, and your company's contact details. Names, addresses, invoices and journal entries stay until their retention term. The account cannot be reopened after erasure. Are you sure?

consent.title: The list of who processes your data has changed, and your decision is needed
consent.intro: We use providers to run the service (storage, backups and the like); they are "sub-processors" of your data.
consent.intro_strong: The law requires your consent first
consent.intro_end: , as you control your customers' data and we process it on your behalf.
consent.version_line: Version {{version}}, published on {{published}} and effective on {{effective}} (with {{days}} days' announced notice).
consent.options_strong: You have three options, all open now:
consent.options: accept and the service returns as it was, download a full copy of your data, or request closing your account. Export and the closure request work on this screen, so you are never locked inside your account.
consent.confirm_body: Your consent to version {{version}} of the list will be recorded with your name and date, and the account will work as before. Do you want to continue?

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.reason_label: Reason for deletion (optional, helps support serve you)
deletion.explain: Account deletion is not immediate: you submit a request that platform support reviews and then carries out. A company without activity has its data deleted permanently; a company with activity (invoices · journal entries · vouchers · contracts · tasks…) is closed, not deleted: access is cut and its data is kept for the legal retention periods and then erased. You can request reopening later.
deletion.confirm_body: Platform support will review your request. If your company has no activity, all its data is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered; if it has activity, it is closed, access is cut, and its data is kept for the legal retention periods. Are you sure?

page.frozen: Your subscription has ended. You are in a grace period for viewing and export only. Renew to restore adding and editing.
page.frozen_grace: Your subscription has ended. You are in a grace period for viewing and export only ({{n}} days left before suspension). Renew to restore adding and editing.
page.stopped: The account is stopped. Renew your subscription to restore full access.
page.no_subscription: Your company has no active subscription. You can view and export your data; adding, editing and deleting open once a subscription is active.
page.export_hint: A single JSON file with all your company's data, always available, even during the grace period.
page.title: Subscription
page.subtitle: Your subscription status and a copy of your data
